body:
`grep ponytail` matches only D-156 in `DECISIONS.md`. The prompts and briefs already state the practices without the name; the code comments are handled by task:2e1aed1bf659c105.

1. Reword D-156's board-task parenthetical and its `Why:` sentence to describe the practices and their benefit without naming their source skill. Keep every rule in items 1–2 unchanged.
2. Do not touch the prompts, briefs, specs or tests: they already contain the philosophy and no name.
3. Leave the completed source task and its notes unchanged: they are the historical record, and rewriting them would lose provenance.

Done when `grep pony` returns no match. No test applies; this changes no code.
title: decisions: remove skill name from D-156
